competitor_advantages.point: Nibble ONE integrates with Expedite's delivery fleet for order fulfillment, and the company states operators keep their revenue without third-party ordering commissions.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Nibble ONE is a catering-specific online-ordering product from dlivrd Technologies (CEO Chris Heffernan), positioned as commission-free and integrated with Expedite delivery.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Narrow overlap with Genius in the online-ordering/digital-menu space, specifically the catering-order niche rather than general dine-in/takeout ordering; unlikely to be a broad POS or payments competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Product announcement dated October 2025 suggests a recent go-to-market push into the catering-ordering niche as of research date.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If catering ordering specifically comes up as a gap, note Nibble ONE as a point solution in that niche; it does not appear to compete on core POS or payments processing.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, pricing, or funding information were found in sourceable material.
